A shark leaping from water is a good clean anime illustration matching the reference style. However 'shark' is a noun/creature, not an action — a language learner seeing this icon would think of the animal, not a verb action. Concept score reflects this mismatch.

Diamond gem with radiating light rays is a perfect depiction of 'shine/sparkle'. Bold dark outlines on all facets of the diamond and every radiating line. Light cel-shaded coloring on the gem faces with small sparkle accents. Matches reference style excellently — the bold linework is comparable to bomb.webp and pour.webp. Iconic diamond shape reads perfectly at 128px.
A bow with a nocked arrow is a clear and unambiguous shooting icon. Matches the cartoon anime illustration style with bold outlines and flat color. Excellent readability at all sizes.
Open mouth with sound waves emanating from it clearly depicts shouting. Clean anime/cartoon illustration style consistent with references like 'blow'. Very readable at 128x128.
Clean claw-mark slash lines in cyan/teal with ink splatter accents. Clear concept of slashing. Anime illustration style with good linework and cel shading. Reads clearly at small sizes.

Cute chibi face sleeping on a blue pillow with blanket and floating Zz letters. Perfectly conveys sleep. Bold dark outlines on face, pillow, and blanket. Clean cell-shading with vibrant blue pillow color. Anime/chibi style face with simple closed-eye expression. White background. Very close to reference quality - similar outline weight and shading to the blanket and umbrella references. Extremely clear at 128px.

Sharp yellow-red blade/projectile shape with motion lines. Anime style with good cel shading. Concept is slightly ambiguous — could read as a beam or energy shot rather than a slicing motion — but directional sharpness helps.
Cute penguin sliding on an ice shard. Excellent clean anime/cartoon illustration style, bold outlines, flat cel shading. Concept of sliding is immediately obvious. One of the strongest candidates.
Fist punching with debris flying — mirrors the reference 'punch' icon in style. Bold outlines, cel shading, dynamic energy. Concept of smashing is crystal clear. Strong match to reference quality.
Coiled snake in clean anime illustration style with detailed scales and shading. Very clear concept. Slightly intricate detail may compress at 128px but still readable. Excellent style match.

Hand with fingers in classic snapping position with orange/yellow spark burst at fingertips. Perfectly conveys snap. Excellent style match - bold dark outlines, warm skin-tone cell-shading nearly identical to the punch reference hand. The spark effect has clean outlined shapes. White background. This could sit alongside any of the reference images and look native. Instantly readable at any size.

Star-burst sparkle with smaller surrounding stars. Concept is clear. Style is clean but lines are thin and the illustration feels sparse/minimal compared to the bold, filled references. Borderline pass on style.

Open pink/red mouth with teal speech bubble containing sound wave lines. Perfectly conveys speaking. Outstanding style match - the pink lips are rendered almost identically to the blow reference (bold outlines, vibrant pink, same shading technique). The speech bubble has clean outlines and the sound wave adds detail without clutter. White background. Reads perfectly at small size with strong color contrast.

Black audio speaker box with music notes. Concept loosely conveys sound/speaking but the object is a device, not an action. Style is more product-illustration than anime — acceptable but not a strong match. Borderline on both axes.

Small cute black spider centered on a large white canvas. Style is clean anime-adjacent but the figure is very small relative to the frame, leaving a lot of dead white space. At 128px the spider will be tiny and hard to read on a mobile screen.
Green and pink concentric spiral with a rotation arrow. Clear spinning/rotation concept. Anime illustration style with good color and bold forms. Reads well at small sizes.

Green seedling sprouting from a soil mound. Textbook clean anime/cartoon illustration — bold outlines, cel shading, clear silhouette. Concept of sprouting/growing is immediately obvious. Excellent all-around.

Three isometric stacked cubes in yellow/gold. Concept of stacking is clear. Style leans more toward a game-UI icon or isometric illustration rather than anime — lacks organic linework and cel-shading warmth of the references. Borderline pass on style.

Pair of brown boots/feet planted firmly on ground with blue energy aura effects. Conveys a grounded stance, though the fighting aspect is subtle - the energy aura helps suggest combat readiness. The boots themselves have proper bold outlines and cell-shading matching the reference style. The blue aura effects around the feet are somewhat gradient/soft, which pulls the style down slightly. The core subject is well-rendered but the effects are borderline. Clear enough at 128px - boots and ground contact are distinct.

Muscular figure rising with a bold golden upward arrow and energy burst at the base. The upward motion and rising posture clearly convey 'stand up / rise.' Art has bold outlines and cell-shaded muscles consistent with manga style. The figure is a bit over-the-top compared to simpler reference icons, but art quality matches. Reads well at small sizes thanks to the prominent arrow.

Yellow five-pointed star with shine sparkles. Clean anime/cartoon style. Concept of 'star' as an object is clear, but as an action icon the meaning is ambiguous — a learner cannot derive a verb action from a plain star shape.

Two intense anime eyes with yellow irises and pink shadow highlights. Style is perfectly on-brand anime illustration — expressive, bold, cel-shaded. Concept of staring/an intense gaze is unmistakable. Outstanding.

Dark shadowy hand reaching for a glowing green gem. The sneaky aesthetic and glowing treasure perfectly convey 'steal.' Bold outlines and good cell-shading on hand and gem. The dark circular background element differs from the transparent-bg references but fits the thematic concept. At 128x128, the green glow provides good contrast, though the dark palette could reduce readability on dark UI backgrounds.

Heavy boot stomping down with cracked ground and flying debris. Perfectly conveys 'step on / stomp.' Excellent bold outlines, detailed boot with proper cell-shading, dynamic crack lines. This is one of the strongest candidates — it looks like it belongs in the same set as the punch and bomb references. Very clear at any display size.

Teal blob with outward-pointing arrows abstractly conveys stretching/expanding. Style is clean cartoon with bold outlines, close to references. Concept is somewhat ambiguous (could also read as 'spread' or 'expand') but arrows help communicate directionality. Readable at small size.

Punching fist with motion/speed lines — immediately reads as 'strike.' Style is nearly identical to the reference 'punch' image: bold outlines, cel-shaded anime fist, high contrast on white. Excellent in every dimension.

An object (helmet/mask) sinking below a clearly delineated water surface with bubbles rising above. The water line and bubbles are strong visual cues for 'submerge.' Clean outlines, the water has nice layered shading, and bubbles are crisp. Consistent with reference style. All elements readable at 128x128.

Anime-style pained face with grimacing expression, cracks radiating around the head, and a broken heart above. The combination of expressive suffering face + broken heart + cracks is unmistakable. Very manga-style with bold outlines and expressive features. The broken heart is universally recognized. Reads excellently at small sizes.

Cute smiling anime sun, perfectly clear as a sun. Style is excellent — clean cartoon, bold outlines, bright colors, matches references well. Concept docks a point because 'sun' as an action verb is ambiguous (shine? warm?), but the image itself is unambiguous as to what object it depicts.

Two open hands cupping a glowing blue orb with radiating light rays. Clearly conveys 'support / hold up / protect.' Clean bold outlines on the hands, beautiful blue orb with glow effect. Very consistent with reference quality — comparable to the punch reference in execution. Simple, uncluttered composition reads perfectly at any size.

Blue spiral vortex with small objects being pulled in conveys engulfing/swallowing up reasonably well. Style has clean outlines and cartoon shading, close to references though slightly busy. Readability is moderate — the spiral concept is not immediately obvious at small size.

Open anime mouth with tongue out and a round object on it — instantly reads as 'swallow.' Style matches references perfectly: bold outlines, flat cel-shading, expressive and clear on white. Outstanding clarity.

Dense cloud of bees/insects buzzing together. The concept of 'swarm' is immediately clear. However, the individual bees look somewhat rough and sketchy compared to the clean precision of the reference icons. The dust cloud outline is lumpy. At 128x128, individual insects will be hard to distinguish, though the overall cloud shape and a few visible bees still convey the concept. Passes minimally on style and readability.

Anime-style swimmer doing front crawl with splash — immediately reads as 'swim.' Style is clean cartoon illustration with outlines, close to references though slightly simpler/flatter. Very readable. Strong entry.
Baseball bat with motion lines — immediately reads as 'swing.' Style is clean cartoon with bold outlines and cel-shading, matches references very well. The motion lines add dynamism. Excellent.

Hand pointing at an open book with a glowing lightbulb above — three universally understood symbols for teaching/learning. Clean bold outlines throughout, well-drawn book with page detail, lightbulb with warm glow. Very consistent with reference style, comparable to pour and umbrella references. All three elements remain clearly distinct at 128x128.

Dark shield/plate shattered into fragments with spark/explosion lines. 'Tear apart' / 'break apart' reads clearly from the shattered pieces with radiating energy. Style has bold outlines and cel-shading, close to references though slightly darker. Good entry.

A piece of fabric being torn in half with a jagged rip down the middle and subtle motion lines. The tearing action is clear. Bold outlines and proper shading on the fabric folds are consistent with reference style. However, the mostly monochromatic tan/beige palette reduces visual pop compared to the vibrant references, and at 128x128 the lack of color contrast may make details harder to parse. Passes minimally on readability.

Excellent match. Hand tossing into a green trash bin with arc motion lines is instantly readable as 'throw away.' Bold black outlines, clean cell-shading, vibrant colors perfectly match the reference anime/manga illustration style.

Anime hand gripping a baseball aloft in a throwing stance with sparkle particles — clearly reads as 'throw.' Style matches references well: bold outlines, cel-shaded, energetic. Slightly cropped/close-up composition reduces readability marginally but remains clear. Strong pass.

Spear/lance with speed lines and an impact starburst — 'thrust' is immediately clear. Style is clean cartoon with bold outlines and flat shading, matches references very well. High contrast and simple silhouette make it excellent at small size.

Rope tied in a decorative square knot — 'tie' concept is clear and literal. Style has bold outlines and flat coloring, close to references. The pink accent highlight is slightly odd but does not impair readability. Good pass.

Rope knot with pink splatter effect. Concept is similar to tie.png making 'tighten' vs 'tie' hard to distinguish — the splatter adds some tension/force but ambiguity remains. The pink splatter is visually noisy and detracts from style cleanliness. Marginal pass overall.

Stone tower tipping over with cracks and debris/dust clouds clearly conveys 'topple.' Bold outlines and cell-shading match reference style, though slightly busier with debris detail than typical references. Debris may compress slightly at 128px but the falling tower silhouette remains clear.

Finger reaching down to touch a glowing surface with concentric ripple circles is immediately clear. Clean bold outlines, skin-toned finger, light blue/cyan ripples, and cell-shading perfectly match the reference aesthetic. Simple composition reads great at any size.

Caterpillar-to-butterfly with sparkle trail clearly shows transformation. Good manga style with bold outlines and vibrant blue/green colors. Dual-element composition is slightly busier than the single-object references; the caterpillar may appear small at 128px, but the overall narrative is still legible.

Simplified humanoid figure trembling with sweat drops and wobbly motion lines clearly depicts fear/shaking. Bold outlines and manga-convention sweat drops fit the style well. The figure is slightly more chibi/simplified than reference subjects but still within the anime illustration aesthetic.

Magic top hat with a question-mark card floating out of it is an iconic and universally recognized symbol for 'trick/magic.' Clean bold outlines, solid color fills with subtle shading, matches the reference illustration style well. Clear and readable at small sizes.

Excellent anime-style turtle illustration. Expressive face, clean bold outlines, warm color palette, good cel shading. Perfectly matches the reference art style (similar quality to the gallop horse). Subject is instantly recognizable.

Clean green anime umbrella with bold outlines and wooden handle — appears identical or very close to the reference umbrella image. Perfect style match. Subject is unambiguous and highly readable at any size.

Orange glowing orb with heat-shimmer wavy lines above it communicates warmth clearly. The orb has a slightly pixelated/textured surface that doesn't fully match the clean cel-shaded reference style — feels more like a game UI orb than an illustration. Concept and readability are solid.

Powerful cresting wave clearly implies washing things away, though nothing is actively being swept off. Style is excellent — bold outlines, cell-shaded blue water with white foam details, very similar to the water treatment in the pour reference. Strong silhouette and great contrast.

Two hands being washed under splashing water with soap bubbles and sparkles is instantly recognizable as 'wash.' Bold outlines, vibrant blue water, clean cell-shading match references perfectly. Slightly busy with overlapping bubbles and sparkle effects, but the core hand-washing gesture is clear.

Clean, expressive anime-style whale leaping from stylized waves. Bold outlines, cel shading, blue color palette with good contrast. Matches the reference illustration quality closely. Subject is instantly recognizable and fills the frame well.

Anime-style whirlwind/tornado with autumn leaves swirling around it. Clean outlines, soft green/gray color palette, good composition. Matches the reference style well. Wind/swirl concept is clear and readable. Slight softness in the linework keeps it from a 5 on style.

Shooting star with a golden sparkle trail and small pink heart universally symbolizes making a wish. Clean bold outlines, warm golden tones, and cell-shading match the reference aesthetic perfectly. Simple composition with excellent contrast at any size.

Anime wolf howling at a crescent moon — classic and instantly recognizable. Clean outlines, anime-style fur rendering, good composition. Matches reference illustration style well. The breath/smoke wisps add charm. Readable at small sizes.

Three diagonal red claw slash marks with blood drops clearly convey 'wound.' Has bold outlines and clean rendering. Slightly more graphic/symbolic than the illustrated-object approach of references, and slash interiors show some gradient shading rather than pure cell-shading. Still well within the compatible aesthetic. Very high contrast and excellent clarity at small size.

A neatly wrapped bundle of cloth/bandage in light blue. Clean outlines, soft shading, matches the reference illustration style. The concept of 'wrap' is communicated well by the coiled/bundled shape. Readable at small sizes. Slightly abstract but recognizable.
